field.label: Enabled
field.help: When enabled, this peer is included in BIRD (bgp.conf). Start/Stop in the table toggles this flag, rewrites includes, then restarts BIRD.

field.label: Name
field.help: BIRD protocol name (must be unique). The include file is /usr/local/etc/bird/peer_NAME.inc.

field.label: Neighbor
field.help: BGP neighbor IPv4/IPv6 address or hostname. Hostnames are resolved (nslookup); host routes via WAN are added for all A/AAAA. BIRD uses the first resolved address.

field.label: Source Address
field.help: Optional source address for BGP session (typically WAN IPv4). Leave empty to omit the statement.

field.label: IPv4
field.help: Enable IPv4 BGP family for this peer.

field.label: IPv4 Import filter
field.help: Select one configured BGP filter. Leave as none to import nothing.

field.label: IPv6
field.help: Enable IPv6 BGP family for this peer.

field.label: IPv6 Import filter
field.help: Select one configured BGP filter. Leave as none to import nothing.
